website.note: No /pipeline page; products VIVO and LockeT featured on corporate site.

devices.name: VIVO System
devices.description: Non-invasive 3D cardiac mapping system to localize sites of origin of idiopathic ventricular arrhythmias prior to electrophysiology procedures.
devices.regulatory_status: FDA 510(k) cleared (Gen 1 June 2019; Gen 2 in 2020); CE Mark in EU.
devices.indication: Pre-procedural mapping of ventricular arrhythmias in structurally normal hearts.

devices.name: LockeT
devices.description: Suture retention device for wound healing, distributing suture tension over a larger area used with figure-of-eight suture closure.
devices.indication: Hemostasis and post-procedural ambulation support after vascular access procedures.

ongoing_post_market_studies.study: Coventry Hospital UK physician-initiated study (50 pts, completed Q4 2024) in re-entrant scar-dependent VT; data planned to support FDA submission to expand labeling in Q2 2025.
Software development underway; planned expanded indications to include ischemic heart disease (preclinical/development stage).
ongoing_post_market_studies.type: Product development, no clinical trial yet.

excluded_preclinical: VIVO Generation 3 software (in development, not yet in clinical trials).
no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medical device company. Both products (VIVO System, LockeT) are FDA-cleared and commercially marketed. No active company-sponsored pivotal P1/P2/P3 drug or device clinical trials. Ongoing studies are investigator-initiated post-market evaluations.
